title: Dependency identity is resolved before REXX_PATH is constructed
summary: Virtual USB dev9 records package-load requirements explicitly. REXX_PATH and native-library paths are derived execution state, not dependency/version authority; arbitrary filesystem first-match discovery must not choose Event Runtime, Crypto or Foreign Runtime.
invariants: Qualified runtime baseline is ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196.
Qualified dependencies are Event Runtime event.runtime/0.1, Crypto v0.8.3, Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 and the ooRexx json package.
PACKAGE_LOAD_REQUIREMENTS.json is resolver-facing package-load evidence; it does not invent a competing semantic source-version system.
Do not use find ... | head -1 or ambient REXX_PATH ordering to select among duplicate dependency copies.
A resolver must select an explicit compatible dependency closure before constructing REXX_PATH, native-library and resource paths.
When Semantic Source Control/Deployment authority is available, consume it rather than inferring semantic version from filenames.
procedure: Construct REXX_PATH and native load paths from that closure.
Run package-load and target-native probes against the same locked closure.
Retain the resolved closure as qualification evidence.

provenance.claim: Package declares entry packages, package-load requirements, qualified dependency artifacts and exported load paths.
README explicitly rejects arbitrary filesystem first-match dependency selection and describes resolver-owned path construction.
